issue.title: test_shell_block_custom_gate_registers_and_lists_row_end_to_end fails whenever the suite runs inside a finalizer-owned turn: tests/conftest.py never scrubs SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN
issue.description:
Found by the agent repairing a rebase conflict in a host finalizer-owned turn, while running the diff-scoped test lane (`just test-scoped`, which escalated to the full suite: 47432 passed, 1 failed).

Root cause: `create_gate_shell` in `src/sase/gate_shell/transaction.py` refuses with `GateShellError` whenever `SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN` is truthy in the process environment (`_finalizer_owned_turn_is_active`, line ~441). The test suite never scrubs that variable: `tests/conftest.py` has no `SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN` handling, so any test process launched from inside a finalizer-owned turn inherits `SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN=1` from the agent shell. Sibling tests already work around this one at a time (`monkeypatch.delenv(SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN_ENV, raising=False)` in `tests/gate_shell/test_transaction_gate_intent.py:166`, `tests/test_finalizer_declaration_channel_recovery.py:112`, `tests/test_finalizers_commit_repair_prompt.py:140`), but `test_shell_block_custom_gate_registers_and_lists_row_end_to_end` does not.

Suggested fix: scrub `SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN` (and `SASE_FINALIZER_PLAN_DIGEST`) in a shared autouse fixture in `tests/conftest.py`, so no test depends on the launching shell's finalizer state, then drop the now-redundant per-test `delenv` calls only where they add nothing (the tests that assert the guard set the variable explicitly and are unaffected). Check whether other tests that reach `create_gate_shell` (question_shell, plan_shell, gate e2e) are exposed the same way; only this one failed in the run above.

task_type_fields.impact: A spurious red test on every verification run launched from a finalizer-owned turn, e.g. the built-in commit conflict-repair turn, where a failing required gate cannot be waved through. It looks like a product regression, so the repairing agent has to prove it is environmental. It does not affect runs outside such turns.
task_type_fields.repro: Run `SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/gate_shell/test_model_shell.py -q -n0`: 1 failed, 11 passed, with GateShellError 'gate shells cannot be created from a host finalizer turn'. The same command with SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN unset: 12 passed. Any agent that runs `just test-scoped` or `just check` from a finalizer-owned turn (for example a commit-conflict repair turn) hits it because the agent shell exports the variable.
